crossRefs.note: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
“You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height…
He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five…
You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;
nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place…
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
“Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

parallels.note: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: He placed the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And he set the altar of burnt-offering at the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt-offering and the meal-offering; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
